title: Oddlings: Wonder in Action Workbooks
formatSummary: 6 screen-free print workbooks across 672 total pages (160-page Home Workbooks & 64-page Portable Travel Workbooks) with 297 open-and-go missions
methodology: Guided by plush-textured companions Tiko, Benny, and Cedric around shared LOOK • TRY • TALK • PLAY discovery missions—zero apps, zero QR codes, zero busywork drills.
summary: Upcoming six-book line of tactile home and travel discovery workbooks for ages 2–5 turning table time, restaurants, and road trips into parent-child observation missions.

title: First Think First Words Board Books
formatSummary: 6 square 6"×6" illustrated board books (20 pages each, 67 concrete observable words across objects, verbs & opposites) with dedicated Page 19 Grown-Up Vocabulary Prompts
methodology: Replaces isolated flashcard nouns with full-scene relational thinking built around LOOK • POINT • COMPARE • SAY (Notice & Match, Count & Compare, Name & Sort, Observe & Classify).
summary: Upcoming six-book Transitional Kindergarten and Pre-K vocabulary board book series embedding core words inside warm, observable scenes with built-in parent talk guides.

title: Human Edge Stories Picture Books
formatSummary: 32-page 10"×10" square hardcover narrative read-aloud picture books (15 illustrated spreads, zero preachy sermons)
methodology: Shared tension with zero villains: children hold two good perspectives together through active listening, visible physical cause-and-effect testing, and collaborative revision.
upcomingTitles: Book 01: The Bridge That Needed a New Plan
summary: Upcoming narrative picture book line for ages 5–8 growing out of the Ages 3–7 virtue series, debuting with 'The Bridge That Needed a New Plan' (hands-on paper engineering & collaborative problem-solving).
